page.overview:
Who is Nora Gitsune?

Nora Gitsune is a fox who filled the role of the "pet" for the Fake Straw Hat Crew, who did not know that the real Chopper is the crew's doctor and is given human-traits by the Hito Hito no Mi.

Nora Gitsune is a light brown fox with black legs. He has a curled mustache and a chain-leash around his neck. He also wears a hat similar to Chopper's, but without the 'X' mark on the front.

While the real Chopper is sweet and patient, Gitsune seems to be more aggressive when provoked, as shown when he bit Cocoa for kicking him. Otherwise, he's fairly passive.

Gitsune bit Cocoa's head, and was able to hang on with his teeth, so he presumably has a strong bite with the strength of a normal fox.
